mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, is_deleted, main_id, convert_after_value, convert_before_value
mapper.select: SELECT cv.id, cv.main_id, cm.main_id AS convertId, cv.convert_after_value, cv.convert_before_value, cm.convert_key, cm.original_key FROM dmp_cfg_input_convert_mapping cm LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input_convert_value cv ON cv.main_id = cm."id" AND cv.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE cm.is_deleted = FALSE AND cm.disabled = FALSE

SELECT cv.id, cv.main_id, cm.main_id AS convertId, cv.convert_after_value, cv.convert_before_value, cm.convert_key, cm.original_key FROM dmp_cfg_input_convert_mapping cm LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input_convert_value cv ON cv.main_id = cm."id" AND cv.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE cm.is_deleted = FALSE AND cm.disabled = FALSE AND cv.update_time > #{freshCacheTime}
